items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: And I only played maybe once or twice with Jim because, like I said, the reception that I got from them wasn't what I thought it should be.

ctx.x: What about people like the Alamo City Jazz Band or the Happy Jazz Band? Anybody out there in Texas, did you play with them ever?

I'm responsible for them organizing that band. Which one? The album? The album. The album. The album. Both of them. Both of them. Both of them. Because they came to me to make an album. And little Jim Cullen wasn't even playing. So I agreed to make the album. But the thing that happened on, as I told you before, I let those men do most of the playing. And when they brought it to Frank Triggs, a friend of mine in Columbia, they said, well, I don't have enough of Don Alvin on. And no voice. And now we're in that…
And you didn't play with Alamo City? No. No. No.
